preconditions.description: The number of cards n must be between 2 and 100 inclusive.
The final number d must be within the range of -10000 to 10000.
The limit l for the initial integers must be between 1 and 100 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not exists_valid_set else True
postconditions.description: If no valid set of cards exists, output -1; otherwise, output a valid set of n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= l for x in output_set)
postconditions.description: All integers in the output set must be between 1 and l inclusive.
The output set must contain exactly n integers.
